KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: Required secret. Generate a long random value, for example `openssl rand -hex 32`. It encrypts recoverable client keys and signs administrator sessions.

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Optional if the administration hostname is protected by Cloudflare Access. Otherwise set a long random admin login key.

NATIVE_EGRESS.description: Required Cloudflare VPC Network binding. Keep the binding name as `NATIVE_EGRESS` and select your own online Tunnel/VPC egress whose public IP can reach `chatgpt.com` and `auth.openai.com`.

scripts.build: npm run frontend:build && node scripts/wrangler-with-vpc.mjs deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run frontend:build && node scripts/wrangler-with-vpc.mjs deploy
scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
